goal: Make the advisory Documents-only merge authorization check report a green Not applicable status (and a green job) on ordinary code pull requests so red means a genuine refusal.
dispatcher: Albert Hazan (repo-maintenance session request for issue #2838)
prohibited_actions: No database, preview, production, migration, claim, lease, or infrastructure write.
Do not change branch protection or required status contexts.
Do not delete or weaken any other check; revocation of the required context must still post failure.
assumptions: The Documents-only merge authorization context is advisory and not in main's required contexts.
A moved head, production freeze, unreadable comparison, or required-context revocation remains a red failure.
stop_conditions: Stop if the fix would require changing branch protection.
Stop if completion requires any file outside the allowed paths.
